decision_boundary.wayfinder_deliverable: Freeze executable requirements, fixtures, oracles, tolerances and handoff gates without claiming production execution.
decision_boundary.implementation_deliverable: Build the separate source project, keep this frozen design manifest at NOT_RUN, retain PASS evidence for every listed gate, and publish a separately verified acceptance-results-v1 aggregate on the required platforms.

parser_policy.file_bytes_measure: raw regular-file snapshot including an optional UTF-8 BOM
parser_policy.record_definition: CSV logical data records after the one header record; physically blank lines are ignored; a quoted newline remains inside one logical record
parser_policy.column_rule: header field count and every nonblank logical data-record field count must be equal and at most 256
parser_policy.field_bytes_measure: UTF-8 byte length after CSV unquoting and before ASCII trim of x/y
parser_policy.malformed_row_policy: malformed CSV is file-level failure; a grammar-invalid x or y in a structurally valid record is skipped with audit

identity_policy.serialization: UTF-8 JSON with object keys sorted by Unicode scalar value, compact separators, arrays in semantic order and no duplicate keys or non-finite numbers
identity_policy.unicode: NFC-normalize result-bearing text metadata; logical row_id remains exact CSV text and raw input bytes remain protected by input_sha256
identity_policy.float_encoding: replace every binary64 in a hash payload by tagged string f64:<16 lowercase big-endian IEEE-754 hex digits>; normalize -0 to +0
identity_policy.integer_encoding: unbounded canonical base-10 JSON integer without leading zero
analysis_projection: canonical units and result-bearing request metadata
LLM advisor mode/config/prompt/schema and frozen accepted-or-fallback ledger SHA-256 when enabled
analysis_exclusions: LLM access token and raw base URL

numeric_policy.normalized_x_collision: fail closed with NONINVERTIBLE_X_SCALE and NORMALIZED_X_COLLISION before solver
numeric_policy.same_platform_prediction: bit-identical canonical model and semantic result
numeric_policy.cross_platform_parameter_scaled: abs(a-b) <= 1e-6*max(1,abs(a),abs(b)) for every canonical scaled parameter with identical parameter names/order
numeric_policy.cross_platform_rmse_mae: if max(abs(a),abs(b)) <= 1e-12*y_scale require abs(a-b) <= 1e-12*y_scale; otherwise require abs(a-b) <= max(1e-8*y_scale,1e-6*max(abs(a),abs(b)))
numeric_policy.cross_platform_decision_guard: threshold-near fixtures must preserve the exact decision; any tolerance crossing is a failure, not an allowed ambiguity

simulation_policy.bootstrap_duplicate_group_rule: sample G canonical x-group IDs with replacement and aggregate their already frozen paired outer-OOF loss contributions with multiplicity; no rows are refit or predicted inside bootstrap
simulation_policy.bootstrap_defined_rule: a resample is defined exactly when its aggregated P1 MSE is positive and both paired loss sums are finite; otherwise it is null with ZERO_P1_MSE or NONFINITE_BOOTSTRAP_LOSS; at least 160 of 200 defined effects are required

source_snapshot_policy.authority: the signed content-addressed ZIP is the release source artifact; the live checkout is a non-authoritative materialization checked only as defense in depth
source_snapshot_policy.members: exact bytewise-sorted source-manifest file list; no directory, duplicate, missing or extra member
source_snapshot_policy.encoding: ZIP_STORED only, Unix regular mode 0644, 1980-01-01T00:00:00 tuple, empty archive/member comments and extra fields, no encryption/data descriptor/unknown flag bits
source_snapshot_policy.bounds: source-inventory-v1 per-file/count/uncompressed-total limits apply before and during member reads; compressed size equals uncompressed size
source_snapshot_policy.binding: source_manifest.source_archive_sha256, acceptance results, every gate evidence record, numerical environment identity and reviewed evidence preimage all bind the exact archive SHA-256
source_snapshot_policy.mutation_semantics: post-verification mutation of a path cannot change the signed artifact identity; consumers materialize only archive bytes matching the accepted SHA-256

release_anchor_policy.caller_input: mandatory --trusted-release-digest with a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 obtained out of band from the accepted release handoff
release_anchor_policy.ledger: bytewise path-sorted unique <workspace-relative path> TAB <byte size> TAB <file SHA-256> LF over every non-symlink regular file under docs/acceptance except evidence/__pycache__/*.pyc, plus the exact specification 01..08 Markdown files and six named specification schemas
release_anchor_policy.verification_order: the descriptor-safe ledger is hashed and compared with the caller anchor before any project-local schema, results or evidence is loaded
release_anchor_policy.signed_binding: release_snapshot_digest is present in acceptance results, every gate evidence record, the reviewed evidence preimage and both Ed25519 signed reviewer payloads
release_anchor_policy.trust_boundary: a caller that executes unanchored or modified verifier bytes has not run this acceptance protocol; the out-of-band digest is the release root of trust

reviewer_authentication_policy.trust_roots: two distinct Ed25519 public keys selected and supplied out of band by the caller through mandatory --reviewer-public-key AXIS=PATH options; results-declared keys are never selected as trust roots
reviewer_authentication_policy.signed_payload: canonical compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON containing reviewer_id, axis, GO verdict, shared evidence_digest, release_snapshot_digest, verifier_runtime_lock_sha256 and SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key
reviewer_authentication_policy.independence_boundary: the verifier proves signatures under distinct externally supplied keys; organizational/process independence of key custodians is an explicit external acceptance responsibility
reviewer_authentication_policy.filesystem_boundary: the key path is lexically outside the project tree; hardlink identity and custodian independence are caller trust responsibilities rather than mechanically inferred properties
reviewer_authentication_policy.unsigned_result: fail closed; schema-valid self-declared reviewer IDs never authorize PASS

llm_policy.ambient_openai_aliases: forbidden; values are passed explicitly and OPENAI_API_KEY/OPENAI_BASE_URL are not read
llm_policy.langsmith: LANGSMITH_TRACING and LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2 must be false/unset; callbacks and telemetry are forbidden
llm_policy.chat_openai_arguments: model/base_url/api_key explicit, temperature=0, use_responses_api=false, streaming=false, stream_usage=false, bounded timeout/max_retries; no tools, conversation state, files or extra_body
llm_policy.scope_rule: one bounded request for full-data and each outer-training registry scope, prepared before solver; outer-test rows are absent
llm_policy.summary_rule: at most 64 deterministic x-bins containing bounded numeric training summaries; never absolute paths, row IDs, invalid raw fields, diagnostics or secrets
llm_policy.output_rule: bounded UTF-8 JSON parsed with duplicate-key and non-finite rejection, then strict installed schema; finite parameter vectors for predeclared replaceable start-slot IDs only; no formula, AST, family, code or prose is accepted
llm_policy.start_rule: accepted vectors replace only advisor-replaceable deterministic slots; anchor starts, total starts, evaluation budgets, registry, bounds, splits, thresholds and certificates are unchanged
llm_policy.failure_rule: timeout, transport, refusal, non-JSON, schema/bounds/duplicate-slot failure gives LLM_ADVISOR_UNAVAILABLE and deterministic default slots for that scope; core continues
llm_policy.freeze_rule: all accepted/fallback scope records are frozen and hashed before solver; analysis_id includes ledger hash; resume never calls the provider again
llm_policy.secret_rule: access token is never serialized, hashed, logged or included in exceptions; raw base URL is replaced by SHA-256 of normalized origin and normalized endpoint under identity-policy-v1
llm_policy.network_rule: off means zero network; enabled means only the configured normalized origin under identity-policy-v1, redirects disabled, no LangSmith/telemetry/update traffic
llm_policy.nonclaim: provider quality, availability and fresh-response reproducibility are not guaranteed; advisor cannot introduce a new mathematical family

semantic_validation_policy.schema_boundary: Draft 2020-12 schemas reject all expressible state contradictions; cross-field arithmetic, equality and independent evaluator claims are rejected by the installed source-known semantic validator
required_invariants: P2 cell lower <= breakpoint < upper and both segment join endpoints equal breakpoint
continuity left/right/shared/residual values equal independent evaluator output within numeric-acceptance-v1
each certificate interval equals its segment interval and certificate identity matches family/AST/direction
certificate ast_sha256 equals segment ast_sha256 and both recompute from canonical_ast
functionally indistinguishable joined P2 collapses to canonical P1
segment row counts sum to n_used and shares are the exact derived ratios summing to one
defined raw recommended global R2_OOS below 0.60 has BELOW_PRODUCT_R2 and no value at or above 0.60 has it
LLM calls_accepted plus calls_fallback equals calls_requested
recommendation R2/RMSE/MAE metric objects equal the selected validation procedure metrics
every frozen gate observed/operator/threshold relation is independently reevaluated and the gate inventory is exact
bootstrap defined plus undefined counts equal requested and requested equals 200
available bootstrap interval lower <= upper and both endpoints recompute from retained bootstrap resamples
split effects length equals repetitions and independently recomputed positive share and p10 satisfy CLEAR_PRACTICAL_UPLIFT gates
semantic_validation_policy.acceptance_binding: MODEL-CONTRACT-002, CLI-E2E-004 and VERIFY-011 must retain rejection evidence for every semantic-only mutant under the frozen source/lock/environment

verifier_runtime_policy.python: CPython >=3.12,<3.13 with -I; isolated, ignore_environment, no_user_site and safe_path flags all required
verifier_runtime_policy.binding: the runtime lock is inside the out-of-band release snapshot; its SHA-256 is explicit in results, every gate evidence record, reviewed evidence preimage and both signed reviewer payloads
verifier_runtime_policy.trust_boundary: the caller owns the prepared runtime and uv executable; dependency resolution or network during verification is forbidden

verifier_policy.strict_json_decoder: strict-json-v1 applies before schema/hash logic to report, model, manifest, COMPLETE, policy, checkpoint, LLM, retained evidence and acceptance-results JSON: strict UTF-8, no BOM, duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity, trailing data or limit excess
verifier_policy.format_assertion: Draft 2020-12 format checks are assertions, including RFC 3339 calendar/time validity; generated_at additionally must match the UTC Z pattern
verifier_policy.schema_trust: validate with installed source-known schemas; bundled schema copies must match their pinned hashes
verifier_policy.mutation_policy: verification must not change bytes, paths, types, modes, mtime or birthtime where exposed; access time is explicitly excluded because a read may update atime

runtime_browser_targets: Chromium 138 or newer with exact version retained in evidence
Safari/WebKit 17.4 or newer with exact version retained in evidence
platform_policy.network_runtime: default/off: zero DNS, AF_INET and AF_INET6 attempts during run, predict and verify after uv sync; advisor-enabled run: only configured OpenAI-compatible origin during prefit advisor phase, while predict/verify remain zero-network

bundle_contract.schema_location: installed source-known production-report.schema.json, model.schema.json and manifest.schema.json; byte-identical report/model copies at bundle root
bundle_contract.manifest_format: manifest-v1 per docs/specification/manifest.schema.json; artifacts sorted by bytewise-ASCII path; canonical compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON plus LF; manifest excludes itself and COMPLETE
bundle_contract.complete_format: exact canonical compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON plus LF with schema_version=complete-v1, analysis_id and manifest_sha256; no other keys

conditional_complete_artifacts.models/one-model.json: required for every exit-0 analysis and otherwise present only for a certified P1 full-data refit
conditional_complete_artifacts.models/two-segment-model.json: present if and only if the full-data P2 refit is independently certified, regardless of recommendation role
conditional_complete_artifacts.models/recommended-model.json: required for every exit-0 analysis and absent for every non-recommendation/failure bundle; its bytes equal the recommended candidate model except for role/recommendation fields covered by its own hash
conditional_complete_artifacts.trace/llm-advisor.jsonl.gz: present if and only if --llm-start-advisor was enabled and the trusted output boundary was reached; contains bounded request hashes, accepted start vectors and typed fallbacks, never secrets/raw base URL/free prose

bundle_contract.conditional_model_rules: ONE_RECOMMENDED may have no two-segment-model when P2 is unavailable; TWO_RECOMMENDED requires all three model paths; a tested certified but unrecommended P2 retains two-segment-model; descriptive/failure states never emit recommended-model
bundle_contract.failure_bundle_conditional: observations/metadata and input-audit appear when a bounded immutable input snapshot was parsed far enough to construct them; OOF/stability/bootstrap/influence/plot exports appear only when their typed state exists
bundle_contract.manifest_path_grammar: ASCII POSIX relative path, total length <=512, each segment matches [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}; no empty, dot, dotdot, backslash, colon, NUL, NFC or case-fold collision
bundle_contract.path_types: all manifest leaves are regular non-symlink files and every traversed component is checked with no-follow semantics
bundle_contract.atomic_publish: dirfd-anchored native no-replace directory commit: renameat2(...,RENAME_NOREPLACE) on Linux or renameatx_np(...,RENAME_EXCL) on macOS; unavailable primitive, path-oriented API or overwrite-capable fallback fails publication
bundle_contract.stale_lock: lock records hostname, PID and OS process-start token; explicit recovery is allowed only on the same host when no live process has the same PID/start token; age alone never proves stale; unverifiable remote-host ownership remains locked
bundle_contract.trusted_failure_boundary: a final failure bundle is required only after the output parent and every component pass no-symlink/no-follow checks, the final leaf is absent, private staging is creatable, and a bounded input snapshot or deterministic infrastructure state is available

fixture_sets.oracle: Schema, skip/audit, row identity, duplicates, atomic ties, 40/60, constant/insufficient and binary64 typed states.
All core P1 families/directions and all ordered P2 core pairs/directions pass exact validity or the pinned typed rejection oracle.
Pooled metrics, fallback, uplift, paired fixed-OOF group-bootstrap and recommendation operating characteristics meet simulation-operating-characteristics-v1.
Residual and conditional selected-structure influence FPR/power, typed zero scale, patterns and strict diagnostic non-mutation.
Existing report-contract evidence: 15 bundles, 1,021 checks, zero failures and two independent GO reviews.
14 finite rows and deterministic parser/replay/E2E invariants only; no family or segmentation truth claim.
37 finite rows and deterministic parser/replay/E2E invariants only; no family or segmentation truth claim.
Exact parser, process, filesystem, browser, network, checkpoint, publication and verifier terminal states.
Full admitted run produces TWO_RECOMMENDED, a usable recommended-model, clipped two-segment plot, predict output and verify PASS.

Local hostile OpenAI-compatible mock proves explicit env/base URL/token/model wiring through ChatOpenAI, per-training-scope non-leakage, strict start schema, frozen replay, secret redaction, endpoint-only network and deterministic fallback.

gates.oracle: Every data-contract invariant and exact parser boundary passes through the CLI/application seam.
Full registry grammar, certificates, PROFILE_CELLS, collapse and hash rules pass; degree four and all forbidden ASTs fail closed.
Untouched known-truth operating characteristics meet simulation-operating-characteristics-v1; full fallback and ZERO_P1_MSE retain exact semantics.

gates.command_or_executor: run demo; verify report; predict demo x; verify predictions
gates.oracle: Exact exit/stdout/tree semantics and a ready typed function plus static report are produced from a test x,y file.

gates.command_or_executor: OS-level network deny/trace around advisor-off run/predict/verify and endpoint allowlist trace for advisor-enabled run
gates.oracle: Advisor-off run plus every predict/verify make zero DNS/AF_INET/AF_INET6 attempts; enabled run contacts only the configured mock origin during prefit and makes no telemetry/redirect traffic.
Only immutable bounded regular-file snapshots are parsed; mutation and every special/symlink type fail before solver.

Each exact bound passes, bound+1 and checked overflow reject before solver, advisor-off demo stays below all limits, enabled advisor call nodes/bytes are pre-reserved, and actual never exceeds forecast.
No-overwrite commit, races, symlinks and injected faults expose only absent or complete verified final directories.
SIGINT/kill/resume, live/stale locks, corruption and environment mismatches follow exact typed states; resumed semantic result equals uninterrupted.
Exits 0/2/3/4/5/6/70/130, one-object stdout and conditional failure bundles exactly match the frozen terminal-state table.
Read-only bounded verifier detects every artifact/schema/hash/reconciliation/path/gzip/JSON mutation without network.
Only a valid recommended role is evaluated; family/hash/certificate/domain/boundary and mixed-row semantics reconcile with report and plot.

gates.command_or_executor: static safety audit plus file:// browser/network observation on both browser targets
gates.oracle: Exact CSP, inert/escaped HTML and SVG, manifest-only links, zero runtime requests, non-color semantics and required reflow/accessibility checks pass.
Paths, environment/LLM secrets, raw endpoint and unsafe raw values do not cross their allowlisted destinations; permissions and links stay private/contained.
Canonical retained payloads and hashes are collision-free under result-state mutation and invariant to operational metadata/key order.

gates.command_or_executor: two clean, resumed and operational-environment-perturbed same-platform runs
gates.oracle: Every same-environment exact field is identical; only the enumerated report-instance projection may differ.

gates.command_or_executor: macOS arm64 and Ubuntu x86_64 replay from one source/lock/policy/input
gates.oracle: Structural fields and decision are exact; per-field values meet numeric-acceptance-v1; each platform is internally exact on repeat.
Every CSV/CSV.gz has local complete typing, units, nulls, keys and reversible safe identifiers matching csvw-contract-v1.json.

Full repeated grouped outer validation, 200 fixed-OOF aggregation resamples and selected-structure LGO refits finish on named hardware; actual task/work/bytes do not exceed the independently recomputed frozen forecast; wall/RSS are retained without SLA.

Default mode remains zero-network; enabled mode uses only explicit MONOTONE_CALIBRATE_LLM_* values through ChatOpenAI, never leaks outer-test y/secrets, accepts only bounded known start slots, freezes a replayable ledger and falls back without changing core budgets.

nonclaims: latency SLA, wall-clock timeout or jobs greater than one
Windows support or equivalent ACL guarantees outside POSIX
Web, API, authentication, multi-user queue or database
encryption, secure deletion, public redaction or automatic retention
cryptographic authenticity or external signature of a bundle
resume across source, policy, dependency or numerical-environment changes
tagged PDF or browser-print accessibility guarantee
XLSX, TSV, stdin, URL or delimiter/locale autodetection
weights, uncertainty columns or multiple response variables
LLM provider quality, availability, authenticity or bit-identical fresh responses
LLM-defined executable code, formulas, ASTs, families, thresholds or automatic registry expansion
